title: Omarchy Flish scenario
description: The world a child lands in. Content, not code: editable without a compiler, and doubling as the fixture a hint's decorators are tested against. A hint that requires target_in_parent is only reachable in a scenario that has such a shape.

id.description: Stable. Telemetry references it, so it is never reused for a different world.

cwd.description: Absolute path the child starts in. Must resolve to a directory in entries.

entries.description: The tree under /. Order is the order ls prints.

name.description: No slashes: nesting is expressed by entries, not by path.

entries.description: Directories only. An empty array is an empty room, which is a teachable shape.
